insert-page-range-into-pdf.title: Insert Page Range from One PDF into Another
insert-page-range-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to copy a range of pages from a source PDF and insert them at a specific position in a destination PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Document and Pages.Insert APIs.

insert-selected-pages-into-pdf.title: Insert Selected Pages into PDF at Specific Position
insert-selected-pages-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert specific pages from a source PDF into a destination PDF at a given page index using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

insert-specific-pages-into-pdf.title: Insert Selected Pages from One PDF into Another Using Streams
insert-specific-pages-into-pdf.description: Shows how to load PDFs into memory streams, pick specific pages from a source PDF, and insert them at a defined position in a destination PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-pdf-pages-at-beginning.title: Insert PDF Pages at Beginning of Another PDF
insert-pdf-pages-at-beginning.description: Shows how to insert all pages from a source PDF at the start of a destination PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Document and Pages.Insert methods.

insert-pages-into-middle-of-pdf.title: Insert PDF Pages into the Middle of Another PDF
insert-pages-into-middle-of-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to calculate the middle position of a destination PDF and insert all pages from a source PDF at that point using Aspose.Pdf's Document and Pages.Insert APIs.

append-pages-to-pdf.title: Append Pages from One PDF to Another Using File Path Insertion
append-pages-to-pdf.description: Shows how to append all pages of a source PDF to the end of a destination PDF by using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.Insert with file paths.

insert-pages-into-pdf-in-memory.title: Insert PDF Pages from Memory and Save to MemoryStream
insert-pages-into-pdf-in-memory.description: Shows how to load source and destination PDFs from byte arrays, insert all pages of the source document into the destination using Aspose.Pdf, and save the combined PDF to a MemoryStream.

batch-insert-page-ranges.title: Batch Insert Page Ranges from Multiple PDFs
batch-insert-page-ranges.description: Demonstrates how to merge specific page ranges from several source PDF files into a single destination PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

append-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.title: Insert Selected Pages from Multiple PDFs into a Single Document
append-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.description: Shows how to merge specific page ranges from several source PDF files into one PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

load-pdf-and-save-with-aspose-pdf.title: Load PDF and Retrieve Page Count
load-pdf-and-save-with-aspose-pdf.description: Shows how to verify a PDF file's existence, load it with Aspose.Pdf.Document, and obtain the total number of pages. It also hints at using PdfFileEditor for further operations.

load-pdf-and-save-copy.title: Extract All Pages to New PDF Using PdfFileEditor
load-pdf-and-save-copy.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfFileEditor and extracting all pages from a source file into a new destination PDF, using Document to obtain page numbers.

insert-pages-into-pdf-and-save.title: Insert Pages from One PDF into Another and Save
insert-pages-into-pdf-and-save.description: Demonstrates loading two PDFs, appending each page from a source PDF to a destination PDF, and saving the merged document to a new file.

rotate-pdf-page-save-to-memorystream.title: Add Text to PDF and Save to MemoryStream
rotate-pdf-page-save-to-memorystream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a byte array, inserting a TextFragment annotation on a page, and saving the modified document to a MemoryStream without any disk I/O.

split-pdf-from-first-to-end-page.title: Split PDF from First Page to Specified End Page
split-pdf-from-first-to-end-page.description: Demonstrates extracting pages 1 through a given end page from a PDF and saving the result as a new file using Aspose.Pdf.

split-pdf-from-first-page-to-end-page.title: Extract First Pages of PDF Using Memory Streams
split-pdf-from-first-page-to-end-page.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF by extracting pages 1 through a specified end page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades with in‑memory streams, avoiding temporary files.

split-pdf-into-bulk-page-sets.title: Split PDF into Multiple Page Ranges
split-pdf-into-bulk-page-sets.description: Shows how to extract defined start‑end page ranges from a PDF and save each range as a separate file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

split-pdf-from-page-to-end.title: Split PDF from Specific Page to End
split-pdf-from-page-to-end.description: Shows how to extract pages starting at a given page number through the end of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor and save the result as a new file.

split-pdf-from-start-to-end.title: Split PDF from Start Page to End Using Streams
split-pdf-from-start-to-end.description: Shows how to extract pages from a specified start page to the end of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and return the result as a MemoryStream.

split-pdf-into-individual-page-pdfs.title: Split PDF into Individual Page PDFs Using MemoryStreams
split-pdf-into-individual-page-pdfs.description: Shows how to split a PDF into separate page PDFs by retrieving each page as a MemoryStream with PdfFileEditor.SplitToPages and writing the streams to individual files.

split-pdf-into-single-page-pdfs.title: Split PDF into Individual Pages Using MemoryStream
split-pdf-into-single-page-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF into separate page PDFs by using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToPages to obtain MemoryStream objects and saving each stream to a uniquely named file.

concatenate-split-pdfs.title: Merge Split PDF Files into a Single Document
concatenate-split-pdfs.description: The example loads PDF files from a folder, appends each page to a base document using Aspose.Pdf, and saves the combined result as a single PDF.

extract-front-part-pdf-splitfromfirst.title: Extract First N Pages from PDF using SplitFromFirst
extract-front-part-pdf-splitfromfirst.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitFromFirst to extract pages 1 through a specified end page and save them as a new PDF document.

extract-front-pages-splitfromfirst-strea.title: Extract First N Pages from PDF Using PdfFileEditor and Streams
extract-front-pages-splitfromfirst-strea.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitFromFirst with input and output streams to extract pages 1 through a specified end page, keeping the operation in memory before optionally saving to disk.

split-pdf-into-multiple-page-ranges.title: Split PDF into Multiple Page Ranges Using SplitToBulks
split-pdf-into-multiple-page-ranges.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF into separate files based on defined page ranges using the PdfFileEditor.SplitToBulks method.

split-pdf-into-multiple-bulks.title: Split PDF into Multiple Bulks Using Streams
split-pdf-into-multiple-bulks.description: Shows how to split a PDF into defined page ranges (bulks) with PdfFileEditor.SplitToBulks and write each resulting MemoryStream to a separate file.

split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end.title: Split PDF from a Specific Page to End
split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToEnd to extract pages starting at a given page through the end of a PDF and save the result as a new file.

split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end-using-s.title: Split PDF from Specific Page to End Using Streams
split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end-using-s.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF starting at a given page through the end of the document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades with in‑memory streams, avoiding temporary files.

split-pdf-into-page-streams.title: Split PDF into Individual Page Streams
split-pdf-into-page-streams.description: Shows how to split a PDF into separate pages and store each page in a MemoryStream using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-pages-from-pdf-file-path.title: Delete Pages 2-5 from PDF
delete-pages-from-pdf-file-path.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a file path, delete a range of pages (2 through 5), and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-specific-pages-from-pdf.title: Delete Specific Pages from PDF Using Streams
delete-specific-pages-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF from an input stream, delete selected pages, and save the modified document to an output stream with Aspose.Pdf.

remove-first-and-last-pages-from-pdf.title: Remove First and Last Pages from PDF
remove-first-and-last-pages-from-pdf.description: Shows how to delete the first and last pages of a PDF by obtaining the page count with Aspose.Pdf.Document and calling PdfFileEditor.Delete with an integer array.

batch-delete-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.title: Batch Delete Pages from PDFs in a Directory
batch-delete-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over PDF files in a folder and remove specified pages from each document using Aspose.Pdf, saving the trimmed versions with a new name.

validate-pdf-page-deletion.title: Delete a PDF Page and Verify Page Count
validate-pdf-page-deletion.description: Demonstrates how to remove a specific page from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, save the result, and validate that the total page count decreased by one.

concatenate-three-pdfs-into-one.title: Concatenate Three PDFs with PdfFileEditor
concatenate-three-pdfs-into-one.description: Demonstrates merging three PDF files into a single document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor’s three‑argument Concatenate method, with temporary file handling.

merge-multiple-pdf-streams.title: Merge Multiple PDFs into a Single Stream
merge-multiple-pdf-streams.description: Shows how to concatenate several PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and write the merged result to an output stream.

concatenate-two-pdfs-using-pdffileeditor.title: Merge Two PDFs into a Single Document
concatenate-two-pdfs-using-pdffileeditor.description: Demonstrates how to combine two existing PDF files on disk into one PDF using Aspose.Pdf's two‑file overload. The example loads each file into a Document, appends pages, and saves the merged result.

concatenate-pdfs-from-memory-streams.title: Concatenate PDFs from Memory Streams to File
concatenate-pdfs-from-memory-streams.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF documents that are loaded into memory streams directly into an output PDF file using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor, avoiding any intermediate file storage.

batch-concatenate-pdfs.title: Batch Concatenate PDFs in a Folder
batch-concatenate-pdfs.description: Shows how to gather all PDF files from a directory and merge them into a single PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs-measure-time.title: Measure PDF Concatenation Performance Using Streams
concatenate-multiple-pdfs-measure-time.description: Demonstrates how to concatenate fifty small PDFs in memory using Aspose.Pdf stream overloads and measures the execution time with a Stopwatch.

compare-pdf-concatenation-paths-streams.title: Compare Memory Usage of PdfFileEditor Concatenate Overloads
compare-pdf-concatenation-paths-streams.description: Merges multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor via the file‑path overload and the stream overload, measuring process memory before and after each operation to compare their memory consumption.

create-pdf-booklet.title: Create Booklet from PDF using Aspose.Pdf
create-pdf-booklet.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF from an existing document using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor with default settings.

create-a5-booklet-from-pdf.title: Create Booklet with Custom A5 Page Size
create-a5-booklet-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates generating a booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf with A5 page dimensions by configuring BookletSettings and invoking the CreateBooklet overload via reflection.

create-booklet-with-custom-page-order.title: Create Booklet PDF with Left-Hand Odd and Right-Hand Even Pages
create-booklet-with-custom-page-order.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.BookletCreator and configure left‑hand pages as odd and right‑hand pages as even.

create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-size.title: Create PDF Booklet with Custom Page Dimensions Using Streams
create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-size.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet from a PDF using stream‑based APIs, then modify each page's width and height before saving the final document.

create-pdf-booklet-in-separate-folders.title: Create PDF Booklets and Store Each in Its Own Folder
create-pdf-booklet-in-separate-folders.description: The example shows how to generate a booklet PDF for each source file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and place the resulting booklet in a dedicated sub‑directory under a common output root.

delete-pages-and-create-booklet.title: Delete Pages and Create Booklet from PDF
delete-pages-and-create-booklet.description: Shows how to remove selected pages from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Document and then generate a booklet with PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet.

delete-pages-concatenate-pdfs.title: Delete Pages and Concatenate PDFs
delete-pages-concatenate-pdfs.description: Shows how to remove specific pages from a PDF and then concatenate the edited PDF with another document using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-specific-pages-pdf-error-handling.title: Delete PDF Page with File Path and Error Handling
delete-specific-pages-pdf-error-handling.description: Demonstrates how to delete a specific page from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor with file‑path overloads, including validation for missing input files and exception handling.

create-pdf-booklet-with-audit-log.title: Create Booklet PDF with Audit Logging
create-pdf-booklet-with-audit-log.description: Demonstrates how to reorder pages of a PDF to form a booklet and log each step of the batch process to a text file for audit purposes using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-to-letter-size.title: Resize PDF Pages to Letter Size
resize-pdf-to-letter-size.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, change each page's dimensions to US Letter size, and save the result to a new file.

resize-pdf-pages-to-8-5x11-using-stream.title: Resize PDF Pages to Custom Dimensions Using Stream Overload
resize-pdf-pages-to-8-5x11-using-stream.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF from a stream, set each page's width and height to 8.5×11 inches (in points), and save the resized document back to a stream using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-resize-pdfs-to-a4.title: Batch Resize PDFs to A4 Size
batch-resize-pdfs-to-a4.description: Shows how to iterate over all PDF files in a source folder, resize each page to A4 dimensions using Aspose.Pdf, and save the resized PDFs to a target directory.

measure-pdf-resize-performance-path-vs-s.title: Measure PDF Resize Performance: Path vs Stream
measure-pdf-resize-performance-path-vs-s.description: The example loads a large PDF, resizes all pages to A4 dimensions, and measures the elapsed time when using the file‑path overload versus the stream overload of Aspose.Pdf's Document class.

create-2up-pdf-layout.title: Create 2‑up PDF Layout with PdfFileEditor
create-2up-pdf-layout.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to arrange two PDF pages on a single sheet (2‑up) and save the resulting document.

nup-to-booklet-pdf.title: Create N‑up Layout and Convert to Booklet PDF
nup-to-booklet-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a 2‑up PDF using PdfFileEditor.MakeNUp and then convert it into a printable booklet with PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet.

delete-pages-resize-pdf.title: Delete Pages and Resize PDF to A4
delete-pages-resize-pdf.description: Shows how to remove specific pages from a PDF and then resize the remaining pages to A4 dimensions before saving, using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-pages-from-multiple-pdfs-in-paral.title: Remove Specified Pages from Multiple PDFs in Parallel
remove-pages-from-multiple-pdfs-in-paral.description: Demonstrates how to parse a list of page numbers and delete those pages from several PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf.

concatenate-pdfs-using-stream-overloads.title: Concatenate PDFs Using Streams
concatenate-pdfs-using-stream-overloads.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files passed as command‑line arguments into a single PDF using Aspose.Pdf's stream overloads.

pdffileeditor-delete-invalid-page-test.title: Delete Non‑existent PDF Page Throws Exception
pdffileeditor-delete-invalid-page-test.description: Demonstrates creating a temporary PDF, adding pages, and verifying that deleting a page number beyond the document length raises an ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

create-booklet-pdf.title: Create Booklet PDF from Stream
create-booklet-pdf.description: Shows how to convert an input PDF stream into a booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and return the generated booklet as a MemoryStream.

create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-order.title: Create PDF Booklet by Interleaving Two PDFs
create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-order.description: Demonstrates how to combine two PDF files—left pages 1‑10 and right pages 11‑20—into a single booklet by interleaving their pages using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-concatenation-page-order.title: Validate PDF Concatenation Preserves Page Order
validate-pdf-concatenation-page-order.description: Demonstrates how to concatenate multiple PDFs with Aspose.Pdf and verify that the resulting document retains the original page sequence by comparing extracted page text before and after merging.

delete-specific-pages-from-pdfs.title: Delete Pages 3 and 4 from PDFs
delete-specific-pages-from-pdfs.description: Loads each PDF in a source folder, removes pages 3 and 4 (if they exist), and saves the modified files to an output folder using Aspose.Pdf.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs-with-logging.title: Merge Multiple PDFs with Logging Using PdfFileEditor
concatenate-multiple-pdfs-with-logging.description: Demonstrates how to concatenate several PDF files into a single document while logging each merge step, using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

create-booklet-pdf-left-odd-pages.title: Create Booklet from PDF Stream with PdfFileEditor
create-booklet-pdf-left-odd-pages.description: Loads a PDF from a stream, writes it to a temporary file, and uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeNUp to generate a simple 2‑up booklet, demonstrating left‑page odd handling via default ordering.

resize-pdf-streams-verify-tiff.title: Resize PDF Pages to Custom Dimensions Using Streams
resize-pdf-streams-verify-tiff.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF from a stream, resize each page to 1024x768 points, verify the new dimensions, and save the result using Aspose.Pdf Facades and Document APIs.

batch-delete-pages-merge-pdfs.title: Batch Delete Pages and Merge PDFs
batch-delete-pages-merge-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to remove specific pages from multiple PDF files, save the cleaned versions temporarily, and then concatenate them into a single merged PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs.title: Concatenate Multiple PDFs into a Single Document
concatenate-multiple-pdfs.description: Shows how to merge several PDF files into one output file using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor class.

merge-pdfs-from-network-streams.title: Merge PDFs from Streams without Temporary Files
merge-pdfs-from-network-streams.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF streams (e.g., network streams) into a single PDF document using Aspose.Pdf, avoiding any intermediate files on disk.

validate-makebooklet-null-pagesize.title: Test MakeBooklet Throws Exception for Null Custom Page Size
validate-makebooklet-null-pagesize.description: Shows how to verify that PdfBooklet.MakeBooklet validates the customPageSize argument and throws an ArgumentNullException when a null value is supplied.

delete-pdf-pages-get-size.title: Delete Specific Pages from PDF and Return New Size
delete-pdf-pages-get-size.description: Demonstrates how to remove selected pages from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, overwrite the original file, and obtain the updated file size.

concatenate-pdfs-with-blank-pages.title: Concatenate PDFs with Blank Page Separator
concatenate-pdfs-with-blank-pages.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files into one document and automatically insert a blank page between each source PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-resize-pdfs-to-a5-and-create-bookl.title: Resize PDFs to A5 and Create Booklet
batch-resize-pdfs-to-a5-and-create-bookl.description: Shows how to batch‑process PDF files by resizing each page to A5 dimensions and then generating a booklet version using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-pages-create-2up-pdf.title: Delete PDF Pages and Apply 2‑up Layout
delete-pages-create-2up-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove specific pages from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Document and then create a portrait 2‑up layout with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

concatenate-pdfs-preserve-metadata.title: Concatenate PDFs and Preserve Metadata with PdfFileEditor
concatenate-pdfs-preserve-metadata.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and retain the original author and title metadata from the first source document.

create-booklet-pdf-delete-resize.title: Create Booklet PDF After Deleting Pages and Resizing
create-booklet-pdf-delete-resize.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF from a stream, delete a specified page range, resize all pages, and generate a booklet version using Aspose.Pdf.

create-verify-pdf-booklet-page-sizes.title: Create Booklet from PDFs with Custom Page Sizes
create-verify-pdf-booklet-page-sizes.description: Generates PDFs with custom dimensions, merges them, creates a booklet using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and verifies that the resulting booklet's page count is a multiple of four.

concatenate-pdfs-in-zip.title: Merge PDFs from a ZIP Archive and Save Back to ZIP
concatenate-pdfs-in-zip.description: Extracts all PDF files from a ZIP archive, concatenates them using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and creates a new ZIP containing the merged PDF along with the original non‑PDF entries.

delete-pdf-pages-cli.title: Delete Specified Pages from a PDF
delete-pdf-pages-cli.description: Demonstrates parsing a page range string, deleting the indicated pages from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, and saving the modified document to a new file.

parallel-pdf-page-deletion.title: Parallel Deletion of PDF Pages using Aspose.Pdf
parallel-pdf-page-deletion.description: Demonstrates how to delete specified pages from multiple PDF files concurrently with Aspose.Pdf, using Parallel.ForEach to improve processing throughput.

resize-pdf-landscape-booklet.title: Resize PDF Pages to Landscape and Create Booklet
resize-pdf-landscape-booklet.description: Shows how to change each page of a PDF to landscape orientation and then generate a booklet using Aspose.Pdf.

test-pdffileeditor-concatenate-empty-str.title: Validate PdfFileEditor Concatenate Throws on Empty Input
test-pdffileeditor-concatenate-empty-str.description: Demonstrates a unit test that verifies Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.Concatenate throws an ArgumentException when the input stream array is empty.

audit-log-pdf-page-deletion.title: Delete PDF Pages with Audit Logging
audit-log-pdf-page-deletion.description: Demonstrates removing specific pages from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor while logging the number of pages deleted and reporting the resulting page count.

resize-pdfs-create-booklet.title: Resize PDFs and Create a Booklet PDF
resize-pdfs-create-booklet.description: Demonstrates how to resize all pages of multiple PDF files to a fixed 1024x768 size using Aspose.Pdf.Document and then merge the resized PDFs into a single booklet PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

delete-pages-from-pdfs.title: Delete Specific Pages from Multiple PDFs
delete-pages-from-pdfs.description: Demonstrates removing specified page numbers from one or more PDF files using Aspose.Pdf and saving the cleaned copies.

merge-pdfs-with-blank-separator-pages.title: Insert Blank Separator Pages Between Merged PDFs
merge-pdfs-with-blank-separator-pages.description: Demonstrates how to create a temporary blank PDF page and insert it as a separator between multiple PDFs when concatenating them using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-and-concatenate-pdfs.title: Resize PDFs to 1024x768 and Merge into a Single Document
resize-and-concatenate-pdfs.description: The example loads multiple PDF files, resizes each page to 1024 × 768 points, saves the temporary files, and then concatenates them into one merged PDF.

delete-and-resize-pdf-pages.title: Delete and Resize PDF Pages
delete-and-resize-pdf-pages.description: Loads a PDF, optionally deletes specified pages, resizes the remaining pages to a given size, and returns the processed document as a MemoryStream.

concatenate-pdfs-add-page-numbers.title: Concatenate PDFs and Add Page Numbers
concatenate-pdfs-add-page-numbers.description: Demonstrates how to merge multiple PDF files into a single document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and then add sequential page numbers to each page of the merged PDF.

create-left-half-booklet.title: Generate Booklet with Left Pages from First Half of PDF
create-left-half-booklet.description: Creates a new PDF that contains only the even‑numbered (left) pages from the first half of a source PDF using Aspose.Pdf and the Facades API.

create-booklet-from-second-half.title: Generate Booklet with Right Pages from Second Half of PDF
create-booklet-from-second-half.description: Demonstrates how to create a booklet PDF that contains only the odd‑numbered (right) pages from the second half of a source document using Aspose.Pdf's Facades API.

insert-page-range-into-pdf__v2.title: Insert Page Range from One PDF into Another
insert-page-range-into-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates loading PDFs from streams, validating a page range, and inserting the selected pages from a source PDF into a destination PDF at a specified position.

split-pdf-into-bulk-page-sets__v2.title: Split PDF into Bulk Page Sets Using Streams
split-pdf-into-bulk-page-sets__v2.description: Shows how to split a PDF into multiple documents each containing a specified number of pages and return each part as a MemoryStream using Aspose.Pdf.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages__v3.title: Split PDF into Individual Page Files
split-pdf-into-individual-pages__v3.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to split a PDF into separate one‑page PDF files and save each page to a designated output folder.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages__v4.title: Split PDF into Individual Page PDFs
split-pdf-into-individual-pages__v4.description: Shows how to split a PDF into separate one‑page PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToPages.

create-booklet-custom-page-order.title: Create Booklet PDF with Custom Left/Right Page Order
create-booklet-custom-page-order.description: Demonstrates how to generate a simple PDF, define custom left and right page sequences, and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet to produce a booklet with the specified page order, then verifies the result by extracting page text.

batch-create-nup-pdfs-3x2.title: Batch Create 3‑by‑2 N‑up PDFs
batch-create-nup-pdfs-3x2.description: Processes a list of PDF files and uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeNUp to generate N‑up PDFs with three columns and two rows per sheet.

create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-size__v2.title: Create Booklet PDF with Custom 5.5x8.5 Inch Page Size
create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-size__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a stream, resize every page to 5.5 × 8.5 inches, optionally apply a 2‑up booklet layout using PdfFileEditor, and save the resulting booklet PDF.

create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-order__v2.title: Create Booklet PDF with Default Page Size
create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-order__v2.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF from an existing document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades with the default page size. The example checks the source file, invokes MakeBooklet, and handles success or errors.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs__v2.title: Concatenate Multiple PDFs Using Aspose.Pdf
concatenate-multiple-pdfs__v2.description: Demonstrates merging several PDF files into a single document with Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor in a console application.
